one_line: Amazon pursues a major acquisition while infrastructure costs, chip curbs, and policy debates shape the global AI landscape.

themes.title: Hardware spending and acquisition pressures rise
themes.text: Amazon is in advanced talks to acquire AI startup Decart for about $7.5 billion. Meanwhile, Chinese tech firms face widening financial gaps and chip smuggling routes are exposed amid US export curbs, while server suppliers raise prices by up to 45%.

stories.headline: Amazon close to $7.5bn acquisition of AI startup Decart
China's top tech firms face growing financial gap in AI build-out
Li Ming central to smuggling restricted AI chips from Southeast Asia to China
AI server suppliers demand higher prices after contracts signed

themes.title: Governments debate legal and military rules
themes.text: UN diplomats failed to reach binding agreements on autonomous weapons, and the Chief Justice of India called for standardized guidelines regarding AI use in legal research.

stories.headline: UN talks fail to produce binding rules for autonomous weapons
CJI Surya Kant urges AI disclosure guidelines for legal research

themes.title: Model costs and capability limits examined
themes.text: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Hydrogen model exhibits significantly higher costs in xhigh thinking effort mode. Additionally, Ethan Mollick noted that current AI models still require human expertise to solve complex problems.

stories.headline: Gemini 4 Hydrogen cost jumps with xhigh thinking effort mode
Ethan Mollick: AI models cannot yet solve complex problems alone
